sun-1: You live life under your own name and by your own decisions; you can't stay long in a role someone else wrote for you. Your body and your manner are the showcase of who you are.
sun-2: You define yourself by what you earn and what you own; income and savings are part of your identity. Standing on your own two feet is a source of pride.
sun-3: You come into your own by talking, learning and telling; siblings, neighbors and everyday routes are your stage. For you, knowledge is a matter of identity.
sun-4: Your identity is built around roots, home and family; where you truly shine is on the inside. For you, making a home is making yourself.
sun-5: Creative work, love and fun are your stage; what you make and who you love define you. Children and play have a place in your life.
sun-6: Your identity takes shape in the work you do and in being useful to someone; the quality of your work speaks for you. Health and daily routine are matters of identity for you.
sun-7: You come to know yourself in the mirror of relationships; marriage and partnership are the main theme of your life. On your own you're not incomplete, but you're not fully you, either.
sun-8: Your identity is forged through crises and intertwined with other people's resources; inheritance, shared money and deep bonds have a place in your life. Every major change redefines you.
sun-9: You define yourself by traveling, reading and believing; higher education and foreign cultures help you grow. A small world feels too small for you.
sun-10: Your identity is built through your career and your role in society; success and reputation are your stage. Your profession comes before your name.
sun-11: You define yourself within a community, through friends and shared goals; the future is your territory. Being different connects you rather than setting you apart.
sun-12: Your identity is also built behind the scenes, in helping others and in your inner world; time alone recharges you. Unseen effort defines you.
moon-1: Your emotional state shows directly in your body and your day; how you feel shapes your manner. Your body reacts to your feelings before anyone else does.
moon-2: Financial security is part of your emotional balance; saving and owning things put you at ease. Your spending habits follow your mood.
moon-3: Siblings, the people around you and everyday routes are part of your emotional memory; your mood finds balance through conversation and reading. Short trips do you good.
moon-4: Home, family and the past are your emotional center; as your home goes, so do you. Roots give you security, and being uprooted shakes you most of all.
moon-5: Love, play and creativity are your emotional nourishment; children and fun have a place in your life. For you, fun isn't a luxury but a need.
moon-6: Work, health and daily routine are part of your emotional balance; you show love through practical help. Worry shows up in your body, so listen to it.
moon-7: Your emotional life is intertwined with your relationship; your partner's mood affects yours. For you, partnership is an emotional need.
moon-8: What you need emotionally is closeness, sharing and complete trust; being only half open leaves you uneasy. Every crisis transforms you a little more.
moon-9: Faraway places, faith and learning do you good; the wider your horizons, the more open you feel inside. For you, travel is an emotional refresh.
moon-10: Your emotional needs are intertwined with your career and your place in society; being appreciated at work makes you feel secure. The balance between home and work sets your mood.
moon-11: Friends and community are your emotional family; to belong, you want a shared purpose. A common cause nourishes you as much as closeness does.
moon-12: Dreams, solitude and intuition are your emotional compass; some feelings you admit late, even to yourself. Short stretches of time alone restore you.
mercury-1: Your mind and your words are the front face of your identity; people first know you by the way you talk. You're remembered most for what you say.
mercury-2: Your thinking revolves around value, money and practical results; if an idea doesn't work, it doesn't hold you. You use your wits to earn.
mercury-3: Communication, learning and the people around you are where your mind works; siblings, neighbors and short trips fill your daily agenda. You live in a constant flow of information.
mercury-4: Your thinking is intertwined with home, family and the past; your best ideas come to you at home. The way your family talked shaped the way you talk.
mercury-5: You show your ideas in play, on stage and in love; for you, the language of flirting is wit. Telling stories and teaching are part of your creativity; this is where your mind works best.
mercury-6: Your mind works on work, health and daily order; you enjoy looking for ways to do a job better. Health topics interest you.
mercury-7: Your thoughts become clear in back-and-forth conversation; partnership is a mental dance. Testing your ideas against a partner does you good.
mercury-8: Your mind digs into secrets, motives and what lies beneath the surface; small talk bores you. When it comes to shared money and inheritance, you want a full accounting.
mercury-9: Big ideas, philosophy and foreign cultures draw your mind; higher education, languages and publishing are your territory. You travel far with your mind, too.
mercury-10: Your mind works on career and goals; you're known for your ideas. Writing, speaking or teaching may be part of your profession.
mercury-11: Your ideas circulate through networks of friends and communities; group projects and shared goals get your mind working. You refine your ideas by debating them with friends.
mercury-12: Your mind works behind the scenes, in solitude and in dreams; your best ideas ripen before you talk to anyone. Hearing what goes unsaid is your gift.
venus-1: Your charm works from the first encounter; your style and grace show in how you look. Being loved comes naturally to you.
venus-2: You experience love and beauty through tangible things; gifts, a good meal and a comfortable space are part of the relationship. You invest in what you value.
venus-3: Attractions start close to home, on everyday routes and over messages; siblings and neighbors play a role in your love life. A day without texting feels incomplete.
venus-4: Home is where your love lives; building a beautiful, peaceful home is your language of love. Family and home life are at the center of your relationships, and you love hosting the people you care about.
venus-5: Love, art and fun are the stage for your affection; flirting, dating and creative work have a place in your life. Children and what you create are channels for your love.
venus-6: Your love life is intertwined with the workplace and daily routine; attraction may spark at work. Health and care have a place in your relationships.
venus-7: Partnership and marriage are at the center of your life; you learn about love mostly through one-on-one relationships. For you, balance is a condition of love.
venus-8: Your love life is intertwined with shared resources, secrets and deep bonds; a light relationship isn't your territory. Breakups change you profoundly.
venus-9: Other cultures, faraway places and education have a place in your love life; someone from abroad could win your heart. Relationships that begin while traveling are your territory.
venus-10: Your charm and grace pay off in your career; a path in the arts or in working with people is open to you. For you, reputation is a love language.
venus-11: Your love life is intertwined with your circle of friends and communities; meeting people in a group comes naturally to you. You want a partner who can become part of your crowd.
venus-12: Your love life also carries on behind the scenes: secret loves, long-distance bonds and healing relationships are your territory. Knowing the limit of self-sacrifice is the lesson here.
mars-1: Your energy lives in your body and your manner; sports, physical work and competition do you good. You'd rather do things yourself.
mars-2: You spend your energy on earning and owning; you're not afraid to work for money. You fight for what you value.
mars-3: Your energy goes into words and ideas; you're on the move in debates, in learning and on the road. Your mind doesn't like sitting idle.
mars-4: Your energy flows into home and family; working from home, fixing things or setting up order is your territory. Tension in the family spurs you into action.
mars-5: Your energy goes into love, sports and creativity; flirting is a game for you. Competition doesn't wear you out; it fires you up.
mars-6: Work is your battlefield; anything that drags down productivity spurs you into action. Pushing your body too hard can affect your health.
mars-7: Your energy flows into the relationship; you want to move as one with your partner, and that's also where friction shows up most. You want a strong partner who's your equal.
mars-8: Your energy works in the realm of intimacy, shared resources and crisis; you're the one who pulls things together in hard times. Your desire is intense, your possessiveness strong.
mars-9: Your energy flows toward far-off places, adventure and belief; travel and sports bring you to life. Your ideas set you on the road.
mars-10: Your ambition comes out in your career; you're not at ease without a goal. Leading or being led is the main theme of your working life.
mars-11: You spend your energy on community and ideals; you act together with your friends. You're at your strongest when you have a cause.
mars-12: Your energy goes into behind-the-scenes work, helping others and inner struggles; you're stronger than you look. Understanding where your anger comes from can take time.
jupiter-1: Your luck lies in your personal ventures and first impressions; doors open when you show up. Overdoing it is this placement's shadow.
jupiter-2: You have many doors to income; finding resources doesn't come hard to you. Abundance grows your spending too, so budgeting is the lesson here.
jupiter-3: Your luck is in short trips, conversations and the people close by; siblings and neighbors bring opportunities. When you teach something, you're the one who learns most.
jupiter-4: Your luck is in home, family and roots; a big table, an open door. Home is where you grow.
jupiter-5: Your luck is in love, play and creative work; children bring abundance into your life. Overdoing the fun is this placement's shadow.
jupiter-6: Opportunities find you in work and health; you grow by being of service. Too heavy a workload and too big an appetite are the shadow here.
jupiter-7: Your luck is in partnerships; your partner broadens your horizons. Marriage and business partnerships help you grow.
jupiter-8: Your luck lies in other people's resources: inheritance, shared money, support. Hard times leave you with unexpected gains.
jupiter-9: Travel, higher education and faith are where you grow; faraway places carry opportunities. Teaching and publishing suit you.
jupiter-10: Recognition and opportunity are on your side in your career; rising in your profession comes naturally to you. You usually get along well with those above you.
jupiter-11: Your luck lies in friends and communities; the network you build carries you. You grow while working toward shared ideals.
jupiter-12: Unseen support watches over you; in hard moments, a door opens. Helping others and working behind the scenes are where you grow.
saturn-1: Proving yourself is part of your first impression; people take you seriously first and get to know you later. Your load gets lighter with age.
saturn-2: With money and property, everything comes through hard work; easy money doesn't come your way. Budget discipline is a lesson you learn early.
saturn-3: Communication and learning call for method and discipline; you weigh things before making a promise. You may carry responsibility for your siblings.
saturn-4: Family and home are your area of responsibility; your roots may feel heavy. Building your own home takes time, but it lasts.
saturn-5: You carry responsibility in love and creative work; letting yourself have fun is something you learn. The work you create lasts.
saturn-6: Work and health call for order; at work, the load piles up on your shoulders. Overwork wears out your body.
saturn-7: Relationships are your school; commitment is taken as seriously as a contract. Partnership takes time, but once built, it holds.
saturn-8: Shared resources, debt and inheritance call for effort and caution; you don't like depending on anyone. When it comes to shared money, a contract is your friend.
saturn-9: In education and belief you walk a long road; degrees and expertise come late but solid. You don't embrace what you've learned until you've put it into practice.
saturn-10: Career and social standing are the main load of your life; rising takes time, but it lasts. Being in charge doesn't come hard to you.
saturn-11: You carry responsibility in friendship and community; you make few friends, but solid ones. In a group, you're usually the one who takes on the job.
saturn-12: Behind-the-scenes responsibilities and inner fears test you; effort nobody sees piles up in you. Spiritual discipline gives you something to lean on.
uranus-1: There's something unusual about your look and style; your hair, clothes or attitude set you apart from the crowd. Your first impression breaks the mold.
uranus-2: Sudden ups and downs with money and property; you find unconventional ways to earn. Owning things doesn't tie you down.
uranus-3: Communication tools, technology and new ideas are part of your daily life; your bond with siblings and the people around you is out of the ordinary. You're the one who starts change in your close circle.
uranus-4: Frequent moves or an unusual setup at home; there may be breaks in your family history. At home, your own rules apply.
uranus-5: Sudden attractions and unconventional relationships in your love life; in creative work you use technology and innovation. Conventional flirting bores you.
uranus-6: Frequent changes and unconventional work arrangements in your working life; technology and freelancing are your territory. You're open to alternative approaches to health.
uranus-7: You set up unconventional arrangements in relationships; sudden beginnings and endings feel familiar. You attract an out-of-the-ordinary partner.
uranus-8: Shared resources fluctuate; there may be surprises around inheritance and shared money. Crises enter your life suddenly and leave you renewed.
uranus-9: In education and travel, the usual route isn't for you; faraway places enter your life suddenly. Breaking the mold comes naturally to you.
uranus-10: Unusual professions and unexpected turning points in your career; independent or tech-focused work suits you. A corporate hierarchy can't hold you for long.
uranus-11: You make friends in unexpected places; future-minded projects and technology connect you to community. In groups, you're the one who starts change.
uranus-12: Dreams, solitude and the subconscious bring unexpected turning points into your life; you find freedom while working behind the scenes. Charitable institutions and technology may go together for you.
neptune-1: Your presence is soft and fluid; people see in you whatever they want to see. You need to draw your boundaries deliberately.
neptune-2: Uncertainty and intuition sit side by side around money; your values are more spiritual than material. Carelessness with your budget can turn into loss.
neptune-3: Writing, storytelling and everyday conversation are close to art for you; what you express is more than what gets heard. You risk being misunderstood, so clarity is your responsibility.
neptune-4: There's a blurry or idealized side to your home and family history; you make your home a sanctuary. The seaside, music and soft lighting give you a sense of home.
neptune-5: In love and art you see things as lovelier than they are; for you, flirting starts like a scene from a movie. Your creative work feeds straight on inspiration; discipline comes later.
neptune-6: In work and health you want a clear diagnosis and a clear job description, because uncertainty wears you out here. Healing, care and helping professions suit you.
neptune-7: You may see virtues in your partner that aren't there, and slip into the role of rescuer or rescued. What you're looking for isn't an ordinary relationship but a spiritual partnership.
neptune-8: There may be uncertainty around shared money, debt and inheritance; keeping the accounts transparent is a must. For you, intimacy lives more in the soul than in the body.
neptune-9: Faith, philosophy and faraway cultures draw you in through your imagination; you easily idealize your teachers. Choosing the right guide is the test here.
neptune-10: Inspiration and uncertainty sit together in your career; art, healing or service may be your path. Your image is fluid, and you're the one who should steer it.
neptune-11: You look for the ideal in your friends and communities; coming together around a shared dream does you good. What you expect from a group sometimes outruns reality.
neptune-12: Dreams, solitude and charitable institutions have a place in your life; your inner world is far richer than it looks from outside. Time alone inspires you.
pluto-1: People notice you at first meeting and don't easily forget you; there's a weight to your presence. You start over from scratch several times in your life.
pluto-2: Power and transformation around money and property; you have a desire to control resources. Losses and gains happen at the extremes.
pluto-3: Your words carry weight with people; one short sentence of yours stays on their minds for a long time. Power dynamics with siblings and your close circle may be a theme.
pluto-4: Your family may have had secrets, ruptures or power struggles; you want to keep control of your home life. Coming to terms with the past is your task.
pluto-5: In love and creative work you put everything in; for you, play is never just play. Your bond with children and with what you create runs deep.
pluto-6: At work you take on a transformative role; in health you go through renewal. Your desire for control shows up in work relationships.
pluto-7: The balance of power is decisive in relationships; you attract an intense partner who changes you. For you, commitment is a decision with no turning back.
pluto-8: You may see big gains and big losses around shared money, inheritance and debt; for you, intimacy calls for complete surrender. Every crisis renews you.
pluto-9: In faith and education your convictions are strong and your power to persuade is high; once you embrace an idea, you build your whole life around it. Keeping conviction from turning into dogma is the test here.
pluto-10: You rise to powerful positions in your career; you may get into power struggles with those above you. Your profession sheds its skin several times over the years.
pluto-11: You play an active, decisive role in your circle of friends and communities; you make powerful friends. Fighting for a shared goal comes naturally to you.
pluto-12: You play an active role behind the scenes; your subconscious steers your life far more than it seems. When you're alone, you're renewed from head to toe.
